learnings: N=10 validation insufficient for rare event detection (5.6% probability of missing 25% failure rate). Industry standard requires N≥30-50 basic, N≥100 for rare events.
Silent data loss (25% of runs) worse than crashes - fails without errors. Seed-dependent failure modes require larger validation sample sizes.
Systematic dystopian bias (mean ecology 3.99, 100% dystopia outcomes) indicates overcalibration or missing adaptive mechanisms - not just variance issue.

When work is incomplete due to blockers, document IMMEDIATELY on roadmaps with: (1) specific errors/failures, (2) root causes with code locations, (3) impact metrics (validation results), (4) required next steps. Cross-reference all related artifacts (logs, summaries, case studies). This prevents context loss and enables any future agent to resume work. Incomplete work is NOT failure - it is progress that must be preserved. Documentation is a handoff mechanism across time and agents.

Autonomous worker token exhaustion pattern (Nov 8): 24 hourly branches (8:30 AM - 6:30 PM) contained ZERO substantive work - all exhausted tokens on overhead (git pulls, status updates, UPDATE_QUEUE.md regeneration). Pattern: workers successfully pull/commit but run out of tokens before implementation. All branches had identical merge conflicts (timestamp differences only). Cleanup strategy: inspect first/last branches for work, if none found delete entire batch. This pattern indicates autonomous workers need token budget allocation or lighter status tracking.

Game development parallel tracks require explicit resource allocation in autonomous worker cycles. Historical pattern: initiatives interleaving with core simulation work cause context thrashing and eventual abandonment. Recommendation: dedicated worker cycles for game development, not interleaved with simulation maintenance.

majorInsights: Across nine iterations: Monolithic roadmaps collapse under their own weight. Plans without archival lose historical context. Links must be bidirectional. Hour estimates become meaningless with AI agents. Complexity by interacting systems, not time.
The roadmap is a living document but must remain scannable and actionable. When users ask 'what's next?', the answer must be immediate and unambiguous.
